definitions.gloss: desalting, removing excess salt, soaking to reduce saltiness
definitions.explanation: The process of soaking salted food in water to remove excess salt before cooking or eating. A common technique in Japanese cooking for ingredients like pickles, salted fish, and preserved seaweed.

examples.japanese: {塩鮭|しおざけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塩抜|しおぬ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塩抜|しおぬ}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please desalt the wakame before using it.

examples.japanese: {塩抜|しおぬ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しょっぱく→しょっぱい：02493_shoppai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦{浸|ひた}して→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧おくこと。
examples.english: If you don't desalt enough, the dish will be too salty, so make sure to soak it in water thoroughly.

notes:
USAGE:
A cooking term used when preparing salt-preserved ingredients. The standard method is soaking in water, sometimes with a small amount of salt added (a technique called ⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧{塩|じお}) to draw out salt more effectively.

FORMS:
⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧ (removing). The ⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧ suffix is productive in Japanese: ⟦{骨抜|ほねぬ}き→骨抜き：27808_honenuki⟧ (deboning), {色抜|いろぬ}き (bleaching), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩抜|しおぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to desalt
- {塩抜|しおぬ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not desalted enough
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{塩抜|しおぬ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to desalt by soaking in water
